required.label: Require a value
required.hint: At least one value must be provided.

multiple.label: Allow multiple values
multiple.hint: Store more than one value in this property.

ordered.label: Preserve value order
ordered.hint: The position of each value matters.

duplicates.label: Allow repeated values
duplicates.hint: The same value may appear more than once.

readonly.label: Read-only values
readonly.hint: Values are intended to remain unchanged after they are set.

key.label: Use as an identifier
key.hint: Identify an object by this required, single value.

minimum.label: Minimum count
minimum.hint: At least this many values must be provided.

maximum.label: Maximum count
maximum.hint: Leave empty to allow any number of values.
